title: Returning to Finish the Job
script: Nabil: [curious] Omar, why are you putting the tools back in the van? I thought the community shelf was finished.
Omar: [concerned] It looks finished, but one wall screw is not holding properly.
Nabil: Nobody will place anything heavy on that side. We have already stayed an hour late.
Omar: [firmly] Maybe, but we promised the center a safe shelf. The loose screw could become dangerous later.
Nabil: Could we simply tell the manager to watch it?
Omar: [responsibly] He may forget, and another volunteer may not know. I want to replace the wall plug now.
Nabil: You are right about safety, but the hardware shop is closed.
Omar: [practical] There is another size in my garage. I can return early tomorrow before the center opens.
Nabil: Will you really come back for one screw?
Omar: [thoughtful] Yes. Finishing a service project means checking the hidden parts, not only taking a photo of the front.
Nabil: That sounds like something your father would say.
Omar: He taught me that people trust donated work too. Free work should not mean careless work.
Nabil: [supportively] Let me come with you tomorrow. We can test every shelf and clean the dust as well.
Omar: Thank you. It should take twenty minutes if we bring the correct parts.
Nabil: Should we leave a note tonight so nobody uses it?
Omar: [carefully] Good idea. Write that the shelf is unfinished and place the tools away from the children.
Nabil: I admit I wanted to leave because I was tired and nobody was watching.
Omar: [sincerely] I was tired too. Sincerity becomes real in the part nobody celebrates.
Nabil: Tomorrow at seven thirty, then?
Omar: [confidently] Seven thirty. We will finish it safely, tell the manager what we checked, and leave with a clear heart.

quiz.question: What problem does Omar find?
options: One wall screw is not secure
The shelf is the wrong color
quiz.explanation: A hidden fixing may make the shelf unsafe.

quiz.question: Why can they not fix it immediately?
quiz.explanation: They need a part that evening.

quiz.question: What does Omar plan to do?
options: Return early with the correct wall plug
quiz.explanation: He commits to completing the safety work.

quiz.question: What will they leave tonight?
options: A note saying the shelf is unfinished
quiz.explanation: The warning prevents anyone from using it too soon.

quiz.question: What principle guides Omar?
options: Free service should still be careful and trustworthy
quiz.explanation: Sincere service includes safe hidden details.

quiz.question: What were Nabil and Omar building?
quiz.explanation: Their volunteer project was a shelf for the center.

quiz.question: Why not only tell the manager?
quiz.explanation: Omar wants to remove the risk instead of passing it on.

quiz.question: Where is the correct part?
quiz.explanation: He can bring another wall plug the next morning.

quiz.question: What will protect children overnight?
options: A heavier object on the shelf
A clear note and stored tools
quiz.explanation: The unfinished area must not be used before repair.

quiz.question: What does “free work should not mean careless work” mean?
options: Volunteer service still needs safe quality
quiz.explanation: People depend on volunteer work too.
